mapper.insert: INSERT INTO galgame (subject_id, translated_name, original_name, info, number_of_ratings, score, `rank`, img_url) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{translatedName}, #{originalName}, #{info}, #{numberOfRatings}, #{score}, #{rank}, #{imgUrl}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE translated_name = VALUES(translated_name), original_name = VALUES(original_name), info = VALUES(info), number_of_ratings = VALUES(number_of_ratings), score = VALUES(score), `rank` = VALUES(`rank`), img_url = IFNULL(VALUES(img_url), img_url)
